skill.summary: Use Yutori’s Research API and Browsing API (cloud browser) to research topics, collect sources, and extract structured facts from the web. Use when the user asks to “research X”, “monitor/find papers”, or “navigate to a site and extract info” and you have access to YUTORI dev/prod endpoints via YUTORI_API_BASE and an API key in env (YUTORI_API_KEY or ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json env.YUTORI_API_KEY).
